description: Manages context windows in long-running AI agent loops — deciding when to summarize vs. truncate, implementing rolling window patterns, preserving critical context while shedding stale state, and budgeting tokens across multi-turn agent interactions. Activates when an agent is running out of context, building autonomous loops that run many turns, experiencing context window errors, trying to keep agents focused across long sessions, managing token costs in multi-turn interactions, or designing agents that need to maintain state across hours or days. Also triggers on: context limit, token limit, context window full, agent loses track, agent forgets, long-running agent, context overflow, too many tokens, context management, rolling summary, compaction, context pruning.
